answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 8409 Country: United States of America Title: Is it ok for a girl whose both parents are syed to marry a guy who isnt a syed when everything else is ok or should the parents wait to see if they find a syed boy? Question: is it ok for a girl whose both parents are syed to marry a guy who isnt a syed when everything else is ok or should the parents wait to see if they find a syed boy? Answer ID: 8409 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1305/1120=L/1429) If the wali (guardian) of the girl is ready to marry her with any non-syed boy, then he can do it. However, it is better that she is married with a syed boy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
